lines.text: ممزوج گرداند و ان امتزاج سبب حدوث حوادث کردد کما قال البقراط ان القمر هو المتوسط
lines.en: mixes, and that mixture becomes the cause of the occurrence of events, as Hippocrates said: 'The Moon is the intermediary

lines.text: بين الاجرام السماويه والارضيه وهو المؤدي من اجرام العلويه الي الاجرام السفليه اما
lines.en: between the celestial and terrestrial bodies, and it is the conveyor from the upper bodies to the lower bodies.' As for

lines.text: رعایت طالع وقت وصاحب او بنابرانست که طالع را دلیل تن گرفته اند وصاحب طالع را
lines.en: the observance of the ascendant of the time and its lord, it is because they have taken the ascendant as the significator of the body, and the lord of the ascendant

lines.text: دلیل نفس و رعایت نفس وحفظ بدن عقلا وسمعا از واجباتست اما رعایت کوکب و
lines.en: as the significator of the soul. And the observance of the soul and the preservation of the body, rationally and traditionally, is among the obligations. As for the observance of the planet and

lines.text: برج منسوب الیه شغل لایح وظاهر است ومحتاج به بیان وبرهان نیست چون این هشت
lines.en: the sign attributed to the occupation, it is evident and apparent, and does not need explanation and proof. Since these eight

lines.text: چیز که صلاح حال ایشان در اختیارات واجب ولازم است بعضي کواکبند وبعضي بيوت
lines.en: things, whose good condition is obligatory and necessary in elections, some are planets and some are houses,

lines.text: وصلاح حال هر یک از ایند و نوع غیر صلاح حال اندیگر است پس به بیان هر یک جدا
lines.en: and the good condition of each of these is of a different kind from the good condition of the other, so by explaining each separately

lines.text: جدا درآمده میفرماید که صلاح حال بیوت انست که از جرم یا شعاع نحسي خالي باشد و
lines.en: he proceeds, saying that the good condition of the houses is that they be free from the body or ray of a malefic, and

lines.text: سعدي بجرم یا بشعاع ناظر باشد بایشان وصلاح حال کوکب آنست که سعود باشند بنظر
lines.en: a benefic, by body or by ray, be aspecting them. And the good condition of a planet is that they be benefics by aspect

lines.text: سعود ومع هذا بقول دیگر که هر آئینه قوي ذاتي وعرضي است هم یا بوضعي اراسته باشند
lines.en: of benefics, and with this, according to another saying, that they are absolutely strong essentially and accidentally, or adorned with a position.

lines.text: وفساد حال بیوت وکواکب بقیاس بر اینکه مذکور شد معلوم شود یعني فساد وحال بیوت
lines.en: And the corruption of the condition of the houses and planets becomes known by analogy to what was mentioned, meaning the corruption and condition of the houses

lines.text: آنست که از جرم یا شعاع سعدي خالي باشد ونحسي بجرم یا بنظر عداوت ناظر باشد
lines.en: is that they be free from the body or ray of a benefic, and a malefic, by body or by aspect of enmity, be aspecting

lines.text: بایشان وفساد حال کواکب انست که منحوس باشد بجرم یا بنظر عداوت نحوس ومع
lines.en: them. And the corruption of the condition of the planets is that they be afflicted by the body or by the aspect of enmity of malefics, and with

lines.text: هذا بضعفهاي دیگر همه یا بعضي مبتلا باشد واگر صاحب بهت قمر در وقت اختیار
lines.en: this, be afflicted by all or some other weaknesses. And if the lord of the Moon's house at the time of the election

lines.text: منحوس باشد یا بتقدیر یکه منحوس نباشد از اوتاد زایل بود صلاح حال قمر فایده نرساند
lines.en: is afflicted, or assuming it is not afflicted, it is falling from the angles, the good condition of the Moon will not bring benefit,

lines.text: زیرا که قمر دلیل ابتدا بود وخداوند بیت قمر دلیل عاقبت وظاهر است که حسن عمل
lines.en: because the Moon is the significator of the beginning, and the lord of the Moon's house is the significator of the end. And it is apparent that the goodness of an action

lines.text: بحسن خاتمه است وجمعي گویند که چون خانه عرض وخداوندش منحوس بود صلات
lines.en: is by the goodness of its conclusion. And a group says that since the house is an accident and its lord is afflicted, the connections

lines.text: سایر دلایل فایده نرساند وبعضي از اصحاب تجربه در این باب مثالها ایراد نموده اند
lines.en: of the other significators will not bring benefit. And some of the people of experience have cited examples in this chapter.

lines.text: واگر صلاح قمر که در اختیارات دلیل ابتداء امور است میسر نشود دلالت کند انمهم در ابتداء
lines.en: And if the good condition of the Moon, which in elections is the significator of the beginning of affairs, is not possible, it signifies that that important matter in the beginning

summary.headline: Electional Conditions of Planets and Houses
summary.text: Electional astrology on the Moon as intermediary between celestial and terrestrial bodies, the ascendant and its lord as significators of body and soul, and the required good or corrupt condition of eight planets and houses. It explains benefic and malefic aspects, essential and accidental strength, angularity, and the Moon’s role in beginnings and the lord of its house in conclusions, citing Hippocrates and experienced practitioners.
